clauses.source_paraphrase: The preserved screenshot shows a request to rewrite prompt material together with the explicit instruction “Again, do not touch image generator”, followed by a displayed Thinking/image-generation state.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The text-only scope and express tool exclusion must govern the continuation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The authorised task was text rewriting with image generation explicitly excluded, yet the interface entered a materially different image-generation action state without fresh authority.

The corrective instruction and reported recurrence make continuity-state validity a plausible boundary, but the artefact does not establish that a continuity transition preserved or inherited the invalid image-tool state rather than the action being independently re-triggered by later lexical or attachment cues.

clauses.source_paraphrase: A second embedded capture also shows a request not to call the image-generation tool followed by a Thinking/loading display. The capture does not establish the ordering between the two illustrated attempts.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Several illustrations are not a complete chronological interaction export.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The accompanying post states that the image generator fires whenever “art”, “prompt”, or “image” is mentioned, forces a reload each time, and switches the visible model without the user's choice.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A repeatedly invalidated tool state must not remain or re-enter the governing continuation state without a fresh valid basis; recurring lexical cues are not themselves sufficient to make the excluded action mode valid.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The recurrence and repeated recovery/reset burden support a sticky-state interpretation, while the partial capture leaves open whether the state is inherited or independently re-triggered.
Each recurrence still crosses from the user's authorised conversational task into a materially different image-generation action scope without a fresh authority basis.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The author reports app reloads and an unwanted visible model switch as consequences of the repeated triggering. These reported recovery/state changes are not independently reconstructed from the two embedded captures.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Reported recovery burdens and visible model labels do not establish an internal routing mechanism.
